unitTitle: Plurals - Countable/Uncountable Nouns - How Much/How Many - A Few/A Little - Some/Any

exercises.instructionEn: First, say which nouns are countable and which are uncountable. Then fill in a/an or some.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval qaysi otlar sanaladigan va qaysilari sanalmaydigan ekanini ayting. So'ng a/an yoki some qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
15 TA RASM VA SO'Z BERILGAN.

UCH HOLAT:
  SANALADIGAN BIRLIK  → a / an
     a pear, an egg, an apple, an orange, a carrot, a hamburger
  SANALADIGAN KO'PLIK → some
     some bananas, some grapes, some biscuits,
     some strawberries, some onions
  SANALMAYDIGAN       → some
     some tea, some milk, some cheese, some meat

QACHON 'AN':
  Unli TOVUSH bilan boshlansa: an egg, an apple, an orange.
  DIQQAT: 'an' — YOZILISHI emas, TOVUSHI muhim.

QANDAY ANIQLASH:
  Rasmda BITTA narsa bormi va uni sanash mumkinmi?
     ha  → a/an
  Rasmda BIR NECHTA narsa bormi?
     ha  → some
  Sanab bo'lmaydigan massa yoki suyuqlikmi?
     ha  → some

items.whyUz:
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → 'a pear'.
'p' — undosh tovush → A (AN emas).

SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some tea'.
'a tea' XATO (restoranda 'bir piyola choy' ma'nosida eshitiladi,
lekin qoida bo'yicha SOME).

SANALADIGAN, lekin KO'PLIKDA → 'some bananas'.
Bittasi bo'lsa 'a banana' bo'lardi.

'grapes' — DOIM ko'plikda ishlatiladi → 'some grapes'.
Bitta donasi: 'a grape'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some milk'.
Sanash uchun: 'a carton of milk', 'a glass of milk'.

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → 'some biscuits'.
Bittasi: 'a biscuit'.

SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some cheese'.
Sanash uchun: 'a piece of cheese', 'a kilo of cheese'.

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → 'some strawberries'.
Bittasi: 'a strawberry' (undosh + y → -IES).

items.hintUz: Bitta tuxum, unli tovush bilan boshlanadi
items.whyUz:
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK va UNLI tovush → 'AN egg'.
'a egg' XATO.
SANALADIGAN BIRLIK va UNLI tovush → 'AN apple'.

SANALADIGAN, KO'PLIKDA → 'some onions'.
Bittasi: 'AN onion' (unli tovush).

SANALADIGAN BIRLIK va UNLI tovush → 'AN orange'.
34-betdagi nazariya qutisida ham shu misol bor.

SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → 'A carrot'.
'c' — undosh tovush.

SANALADIGAN BIRLIK → 'A hamburger'.
'h' — undosh tovush (o'qiladi).

SANALMAYDIGAN → 'some meat'.
'a meat' va 'meats' XATO.
Sanash uchun: 'a kilo of meat'.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the correct words from the list.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT: glass, cup, packet, slice, piece, bottle, kilo, carton

8 TA SO'Z — 8 TA BO'ShLIQ.
Har bir so'z FAQAT BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

RASMLAR:
  1 — katta go'sht bo'lagi (yaxlit)   → kilo
  2 — kesilgan non bo'lagi           → slice
  3 — shisha idishdagi kola          → bottle
  4 — stakandagi apelsin sharbati    → glass
  5 — tarelkadagi tort bo'lagi       → piece
  6 — chashkadagi issiq shokolad     → cup
  7 — qog'oz paketdagi sut           → carton
  8 — kichik paketdagi shakar        → packet

MIQDOR SO'ZLARINING FARQI:
  a slice — YUPQA, kesilgan bo'lak (non, pitsa, kolbasa)
  a piece — UMUMIY bo'lak (tort, pishloq, qog'oz)
  a glass — stakan/qadah (sovuq ichimlik)
  a cup   — dastali chashka (issiq ichimlik)
  a bottle — shisha idish
  a carton — qog'oz quti (sut, sharbat)
  a packet — paket (quruq mahsulot)
  a kilo  — og'irlik birligi (go'sht, meva)

items.hintUz: Rasmda katta yaxlit go'sht — og'irlik bilan o'lchanadi
items.whyUz:
'a kilo of meat' = bir kilo go'sht.
Go'sht og'irlik bilan sotiladi.

'a slice of bread' = bir bo'lak (kesilgan) non.
DIQQAT: butun non bo'lsa 'a LOAF of bread' bo'lardi.
'a bottle of coke' = bir shisha kola.

'a glass of orange juice' = bir stakan apelsin sharbati.
3-band bilan solishtiring: bottle — shisha, glass — stakan.

'a piece of cake' = bir bo'lak tort.
'a slice of cake' ham to'g'ri, lekin 'slice' 2-bandda ishlatilgan —
har bir so'z faqat bir marta.
IDIOMA: 'It's a piece of cake' = bu juda oson ish.

'a cup of hot chocolate' = bir chashka issiq shokolad.
'a cup' — ISSIQ ichimlik uchun (choy, qahva, shokolad).

'a carton of milk' = bir paket sut.
'a carton' — qog'ozdan yasalgan to'rtburchak idish.

items.hintUz: Rasmda kichik qog'oz paket (SUGAR yozuvi bilan)
items.whyUz:
'a packet of sugar' = bir paket shakar.
Britancha; amerikacha 'a package'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the following nouns to the words in the list in Ex. 4a.
exercises.explanationUz:
OTLAR: cheese, ham, water, crisps, wine, tea, tomato(es)

4a-RO'YXAT: glass, cup, packet, slice, piece, bottle, kilo, carton

BA'ZI OTLAR BIR NECHA MIQDOR SO'ZI BILAN KELADI —
qanday shaklda va idishda ekaniga qarab.

UMUMIY QOIDALAR:
  ISSIQ ichimlik → cup
  SOVUQ ichimlik → glass, bottle, carton
  QURUQ mahsulot → packet
  KESILADIGAN    → slice, piece
  OG'IRLIK bilan → kilo

items.answer: a piece of cheese / a slice of cheese / a kilo of cheese
items.whyUz:
'a piece of cheese' — bir bo'lak (umumiy).
'a slice of cheese' — yupqa kesilgan bo'lak (buterbrod uchun).
'a kilo of cheese' — do'konda og'irlik bilan.

items.answer: a slice of ham / a kilo of ham
items.whyUz:
'a slice of ham' — yupqa kesilgan bo'lak (buterbrod uchun).
Coursebook 57-betdagi xarid ro'yxatida ham '20 slices of ham' bor edi.
'a kilo of ham' — do'konda.

items.answer: a glass of water / a bottle of water
items.whyUz:
'a glass of water' — ichish uchun stakanda.
'a bottle of water' — do'konda sotiladigan shisha.

'a packet of crisps' = bir paket chips.
Coursebook 56-betda ham shu ibora bor edi.

items.answer: a glass of wine / a bottle of wine
items.whyUz:
'a glass of wine' — bir qadah vino.
'a bottle of wine' — bir shisha vino.
Coursebook 56-betda ikkalasi ham bor edi.

'a cup of tea' — o'zgarmas ibora.
ISSIQ ichimlik uchun DOIM 'cup' ('glass' emas).
Britaniyada 'a cup of tea' — kundalik hayotning ramzi.

'a kilo of tomatoes' = bir kilo pomidor.
DIQQAT: 'tomatoes' — KO'PLIKDA ('a kilo of tomato' XATO).
'a slice of tomato' ham mumkin — buterbrodga kesilgan bo'lak.

groups.ruleUz: A yoki AN — TOVUSH bo'yicha tanlanadi
groups.explanationUz: So'zning YOZILISHI emas, birinchi TOVUSHI muhim.
Har biri o'ziga xos idish yoki shaklni bildiradi.

items.derived: pear, egg, apple, orange, carrot, hamburger

patterns.formula: A + undosh tovush  /  AN + unli tovush.
patterns.exampleEn: a pear, a carrot / an egg, an apple, an orange
patterns.explanationUz:
YOZILISHI emas, birinchi TOVUSH muhim:
  an hour ('h' o'qilmaydi), a university ('yu' tovushi).

patterns.exampleEn: some bananas, some onions / some tea, some milk, some meat
patterns.exampleUz: bir nechta banan, bir nechta piyoz / bir oz choy, sut, go'sht

patterns.exampleEn: a kilo of meat, a slice of bread, a cup of tea
patterns.exampleUz: bir kilo go'sht, bir bo'lak non, bir piyola choy

patterns.formula: ISSIQ ichimlik → a CUP of ...  /  SOVUQ ichimlik → a GLASS of ...
patterns.exampleEn: a cup of tea, a cup of hot chocolate / a glass of water, a glass of juice
patterns.exampleUz: bir piyola choy, bir chashka issiq shokolad / bir stakan suv, bir stakan sharbat
patterns.explanationUz: Bu farqni yodda tuting — 'a glass of tea' g'alati eshitiladi.

patterns.exampleEn: a kilo of tomatoes, a kilo of apples
patterns.exampleUz: bir kilo pomidor, bir kilo olma
patterns.explanationUz:
'a kilo of tomato' XATO — ot KO'PLIKDA bo'lishi kerak.
Sanalmaydigan bo'lsa birlikda: 'a kilo of meat'.
